caption: The drawing depicts two shoe outlines displayed side by side on an off-white, slightly yellowed and speckled background. The shoe on the left is shown from the sole view, with a rounded toe and a scalloped or frilled edge around the heel and back. The shoe on the right is shown from the top, displaying a rounded toe, a similarly scalloped or frilled upper edge around the heel, and a lace-up front with six eyelets visible along the right side. The lines are thin and black, and the drawing contains no color filling or shading. There are minor brownish spots scattered across the background, which is otherwise blank.
title: Baby Shoe
